senses.en_definition: I don't know; I can't say, often expressing uncertainty, resignation, or reluctance to judge.

collocations.en: I'm not sure. It's hard to say.

messages.en: Is Amir coming tonight or not? How many should we book a table for?
No idea. He hasn't replied yet. Maybe he's busy. Just book for the three of us for now.

senses.en_definition: Tomorrow; on the day after today.
In the future; at some later time, not necessarily the next day.

collocations.en: tomorrow or the day after; sometime in the future
in the future, when you're grown up

messages.en: Want to have breakfast at our usual place tomorrow? Is eight okay?
Eight's way too early. How about eight thirty?
Sure. I'll wait for you outside the place tomorrow.

senses.en_definition: To understand clearly the meaning or nature of something.
Understanding; a mental grasp or interpretation of something.
An opinion or view held by someone.
An ideology or system of beliefs held by an individual or society.

messages.en: The fee includes lunch. Just show the code in your email when you get there.
Oh, I get it now. I thought we had to pay extra for lunch, but it turns out we don't.
The blue file's on your desk already, just so you know.
Thanks! I'll go through it after lunch.
